title: SupraTITO: Transferable Generative Molecular Dynamics for Supramolecular Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.01381v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Peptide sequence governs both the structures formed through supramolecular assembly and the dynamics by which they emerge, but predicting either requires resolving slow collective processes among many interacting molecules. Molecular dynamics (MD) provides microscopic insight into these processes, yet the long timescales of assembly and the vast peptide sequence space make systematic exploration computationally demanding. We introduce SupraTITO, a transferable generative molecular dynamics (GenMD) framework for supramolecular systems, demonstrated through peptide self-assembly. SupraTITO learns transferable implicit transfer operators (TITO) conditioned on peptide sequence, molecular topology, and periodic geometry, allowing configurations to be propagated over physical intervals much longer than an MD integration step. translated_title: SupraTITO：面向超分子体系的可迁移生成式分子动力学
translated_abstract: 肽序列既决定了超分子组装所形成的结构，也决定了这些结构形成的动力学过程，但要预测其中任何一个，都需要解析众多相互作用分子之间缓慢的集体过程。分子动力学（MD）为这些过程提供了微观层面的洞察，然而组装过程的长时间尺度以及庞大的肽序列空间，使得系统性探索在计算上代价高昂。我们提出了SupraTITO，一个面向超分子体系的可迁移生成式分子动力学框架，并以肽自组装为例进行了验证。SupraTITO学习以肽序列、分子拓扑和周期几何为条件的可迁移隐式转移算子，使构型能够在远长于MD单步积分的物理时间间隔上进行传播。在一个全面的双肽基准测试中，SupraTITO能够泛化到训练中未见过的序列，并再现序列依赖的……
tldr: 提出可迁移生成式分子动力学框架SupraTITO，通过学习以肽序列、分子拓扑和周期几何为条件的隐式转移算子，实现远超传统MD积分步长的时间尺度传播，并能泛化到未见肽序列，从而高效预测超分子自组装。
en_tdlr: SupraTITO is a transferable generative molecular dynamics framework that learns implicit transfer operators conditioned on peptide sequence, molecular topology, and periodic geometry, enabling configuration propagation over timescales far beyond a single MD integration step while generalizing to held-out peptide sequences for supramolecular self-assembly.
